subject: Invoice routing and email grace-path + compact CSV schema for multi-PO invoices
messages:
From: AdeptPayments <ops@adeptpayments.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-25T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Vanessa / Redwood team,

Weʼre completing the vendor setup for Redwood and wanted to confirm the preferred invoice submission flow. Our ERP can either push invoices to a hosted portal (SaaS API) or send a single consolidated CSV to an email address (one file per day).

A few specific questions:
- Do you require portal onboarding for early production, or is email CSV acceptable as a permanent flow?
- If email is allowed as a fallback, what subject/filename conventions and token you need so invoices route to the right account and PO match?
- Can a single invoice file contain multiple invoices mapping to multiple Redwood POs (we typically batch per customer per day)?
- Any minimal required columns? We included a stub CSV (attached) with 1-line examples.

Attachment: adept-sample-invoices.csv (CSV with columns: file_id,invoice_number,invoice_date,po,amount,currency,tax)

Thanks — happy to hop on a 20-min call if thatʼs easier.

— Priya Das
Ops Lead, AdeptPayments
ops@adeptpayments.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com
To: AdeptPayments <ops@adeptpayments.com>
Cc: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-25T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Priya — thanks for the samples and questions. Short answers up front: portal preferred; email CSV is supported as a long-term fallback if you follow the naming and payload rules below.

Policy summary (recommended):
- Portal-first: Our onboarding portal gives faster ACKs, PO matching guarantees, and idempotency tokens. If you can use the portal, we strongly recommend it. Link: https://redwood.example.com/onboarding/forms/vendor-intake?ref=adept-123
- Email grace-path: Send a single CSV to ap-invoices@redwood.example.com with the subject token: REDWOOD_VENDOR:adept-ops and filename pattern: RW_VENDOR_adept-YYYYMMDD.csv. We will auto-route using that token.
- Multi-PO in one file: Allowed. Each invoice row must include a PO_NUMBER column. If multiple POs are combined into a single invoice, include a line-per-lineitem with PO_NUMBER repeated per line item.
- Minimal required columns (compact schema we accept): INVOICE_NUMBER, INVOICE_DATE (YYYY-MM-DD), PO_NUMBER, DESCRIPTION, LINE_AMT, CURRENCY (USD), TAX_AMOUNT, SUPPLIER_TAX_ID
- Totals: we prefer per-invoice totals but will compute if you provide line items and TAX_AMOUNT per line.
- Attachments: If you need to include a PDF copy of an invoice, add a separate email with subject "ATTACH:RW:adept-ops:INV-<invoice_number>" and reference the CSV row. PDFs are processed asynchronously.

I attached our short guidance PDF for vendor teams (redwood-invoice-guidelines-v1.pdf). Below is a compact sample row (CSV) you can copy:

"INVOICE_NUMBER,INVOICE_DATE,PO_NUMBER,DESCRIPTION,LINE_AMT,CURRENCY,TAX_AMOUNT,SUPPLIER_TAX_ID"
"INV-2027-1001,2027-08-20,PO-5543,Monthly inference credits,1200.00,USD,120.00,98-7654321"

Operational notes:
- SFTP/S3 ingestion can be discussed if email volume grows.
- For PO stamping and three-way match, include the PO_NUMBER exactly as Redwood issues it (case-insensitive but punctuation-sensitive).
- If youʼre sending consolidated invoices that mix multiple Redwood entities, include column ENTITY_ID. We will split to the right ledger if ENTITY_ID is present.

Next steps: if you confirm you will use the email grace-path, send a small pilot file (1–5 rows) tomorrow and weʼll validate. Otherwise click the portal link for faster onboarding.

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Manager, Vendor Onboarding
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com

Thanks Vanessa — thatʼs helpful. A couple quick clarifications before we run a pilot:
1) If a single CSV row contains an invoice that should be applied to two POs (split billing), do you prefer two rows (one per PO) or can we include a PO_LIST field?
2) How do you handle tax breakdowns when the buyer and supplier are in different states? We typically provide a TAX_RATE and TAX_AMOUNT per line but not always an explicit tax jurisdiction.

We can do the portal but will probably start with an email pilot next week while our integration team finishes the API work.

— Priya

From: jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
To: AdeptPayments <ops@adeptpayments.com>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.example.com, marissa_cole@redwood.example.com
Date: 2027-08-26T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: New vendor onboarding — invoice submission question

Hi Priya — Jordan here from Procurement (copied Vanessa). Quick operational guidance to the two clarifications: 

1) Split billing / multiple POs: Please use one CSV row per PO × lineitem. If a single invoice amount must be split across 2 POs, include two rows with the same INVOICE_NUMBER and distinct PO_NUMBERs and LINE_AMT values that sum to the invoice total. Avoid a PO_LIST field — our ingestion pipeline cannot reliably expand lists.

2) Tax handling: TAX_AMOUNT per line is sufficient. If you can provide TAX_RATE and TAX_JURISDICTION columns, thatʼs ideal for our tax team, but TAX_AMOUNT + SUPPLIER_TAX_ID works for initial processing. If there are cross-jurisdiction complexities we may follow up for tax paperwork.

Pilot checklist (please send in order):
- Pilot CSV to ap-invoices@redwood.example.com with subject line containing REDWOOD_VENDOR:adept-ops
- Filename: RW_VENDOR_adept-20270826.csv
- Include column headers exactly as our guide shows (INVOICE_NUMBER,INVOICE_DATE,PO_NUMBER,DESCRIPTION,LINE_AMT,CURRENCY,TAX_AMOUNT, SUPPLIER_TAX_ID)
- If including PDFs, send separate email with subject ATTACH:RW:adept-ops:INV-<invoice_number> and attach the PDF.

Weʼll validate the pilot and send you an ACK with any mapping exceptions within 24 hours. If all good, we can flip to automated processing or discuss portal onboarding timeline.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Procurement Operations
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.example.com
